_about: Dated exceptions for the dev-tooling npm audit (scripts/audit_exceptions.mjs). Each names one advisory and the package it is reported in, and ends on `expires` (the first date it no longer applies), so the audit fails again by itself. The production audit never reads this file.

exceptions.reason: Dev tooling only: the minimatch 10.2.6 nested under eslint and @eslint/config-array (production audit clean; the site does not ship it). The only fix, minimatch 11.0.1, was published 2026-10-27; the 14-day pinning rule allows it from 2026-11-10, and it is outside eslint's ^10 range. On that date, pin it (an npm override, if eslint passes with it) or take an eslint release that depends on it, and remove this exception.
